Viktor Nguyen
viktor.nguyen@example.com | Atlanta, GA
Viktor Nguyen has 10 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Staff Backend Engineer at Palodex Data (2024-2026), where they
designed a REST API design-backed data layer that cut p99 query latency by 49%.
Before that, Senior Backend Engineer at Quartzline Dynamics (2021-2024). Before
that, Backend Engineer at Cobalt Systems (2017-2021). Before that, Software
Engineer I at Sable Systems (2016-2017). Education: B.S. Software Engineering,
University of Wisconsin-Madison, 2015. Core skills: PostgreSQL, REST API
design, Distributed systems, GraphQL, AWS, Node.js, TypeScript.
